$comment: Light loops: the site's own light images (brand/assets/art) drifting slowly on Black behind the lockup and the site's ASCII texture tile. Each template is a scene at 1080 by 1080 that other sizes cover by scaling it from the center. Motion follows the animation rules: it only exists to make the light flow, as the site's hero band drifts; it never eases in, the drift is constant motion (a linear phase around a closed figure eight, so the last frame meets the first; the sine path slows at its turns as the site's drift curve does), slow (one loop in `seconds`), and nothing else moves. Stings (logo-reveal, outro) are not loops: the light sweeps once on the ease-out curve and only the lockup fades in or out. --still writes the first frame alone for reduced motion.

templates.name: Light band
templates.description: A light ribbon across the middle drifts sideways.

templates.name: Corner lights
templates.description: Two corner lights flow in from the edges around an empty middle.

templates.name: Close band
templates.description: The close band runs across the top on the diagonal and drifts.

templates.name: Upright ribbons
templates.description: Two light ribbons upright at the edges drift up and down.

templates.name: Logo reveal
templates.description: A sting, not a loop: the light ribbon sweeps across once and the lockup comes in at the center, then holds.

templates.name: Outro
templates.description: A closing sting: the corner lights sweep once around the lockup and the address, and the lockup leaves at the end.
